repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-flag
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin registered as webex.internal.flag. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and @webex/internal-plugin-device for their side effects and registers the Flag plugin with an empty config under the flag key. Flag creates and lists activity flags through catalog service userApps (resource /flags), archives, unflags, or deletes a flag through its url, and maps flags to activities with one bulk_activities_fetch request per conversation URL whose prefix the service catalog names as service conversation.

flag-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and @webex/internal-plugin-device for their side effects and registers Flag as the internal plugin 'flag' with config {flag: {}} and empty payload-transformer predicate and transform lists. The barrel src/index.js exports only Flag as default. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host contract consumed by Flag: WebexPlugin.extend supplies this.webex, this.logger, this.config, and request(), which delegates to webex.request; registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin and merges its config; mapToActivities calls webex.internal.services.waitForCatalog('postauth') and getServiceFromUrl.

conversation-sdk.summary: Imported for its registration side effect in src/index.js. Its inbound payload predicates, including the one on body.multistatus, can run on this package's responses through webex-core's PayloadTransformerInterceptor when it is in the interceptor set (default set; see src/docs/README.md Dependencies); create reads the conversation activity fields url and target.url. Owned by @webex/internal-plugin-conversation.

webex-device-registration.summary: Imported for its registration side effect in src/index.js only; src/ calls no device API. Owned and specified by @webex/internal-plugin-device.

user-apps-flags-http.source: User-apps flags service REST API (catalog service 'userApps', resource /flags)
user-apps-flags-http.summary: Consumed, not served. create sends POST /flags with body keys conversation-url (omitted when activity.target.url is undefined), flag-item, and state flagged; list sends GET /flags with qs state flagged and reads body.items; archive and unflag send PUT to a flag's url with state archived or unflagged; delete sends DELETE to a flag's url. Fields read by this package are listed under Protocol and wire format in src/docs/README.md.

conversation-bulk-activities-http.source: Conversation service bulk_activities_fetch endpoint on a catalog 'conversation' URL
conversation-bulk-activities-http.summary: Consumed, not served. mapToActivities sends POST <conversation URL>/bulk_activities_fetch with body {activityUrls} and reads body.multistatus[].status and data.activity.
